title: pleurogramme linearis
intro: Pleurogramme linearis, commonly known as the "Venus hair fern," is a species of fern that belongs to the family Pleurogrammaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pleurogramme linearis include its diuretic and antiseptic properties, which may help to reduce fever and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
